mapper.select: SELECT @@server_uuid AS serverUuid, DATABASE() AS schemaName

SELECT account_id AS sourceId, channel_id AS channelId, fb_account_id AS accountId, account_type AS accountType, whitelist_type AS attribute, tenant_id AS tenantId FROM fbad_channel_account ORDER BY account_id LIMIT 100001

SELECT id AS sourceId, channel_name AS channelName, channel_short_name AS channelShortName, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_type AS channelType, belong_team AS belongTeam, status, settlement_method AS settlementMethod, settlement_currency AS settlementCurrency, buyout_amount AS buyoutAmount, payment_address AS paymentAddress, login_url AS loginUrl, remark, tg_group_id AS tgGroupId, tg_group_name AS tgGroupName, tenant_id AS tenantId, create_time AS createdAt, update_time AS updatedAt FROM fbad_channel ORDER BY id LIMIT 10001

SELECT id AS sourceId, channel_id AS sourceChannelId, service_fee AS serviceFee, rebate_rate AS rebateRate, effective_date AS effectiveDate, expiry_date AS expiryDate, status, damage_rate AS damageRate, opening_fee AS openingFee, opening_fee_unit AS openingFeeUnit, create_time AS createdAt, update_time AS updatedAt FROM fbad_channel_rate ORDER BY id LIMIT 10001

SELECT payment.id AS sourceId, payment.order_no AS orderNo, payment.user_id AS requesterSourceId, requester.nick_name AS requesterName, requester.phonenumber AS requesterPhone, requester.tenant_id AS requesterTenantId, department.dept_name AS sourceDepartmentName, payment.channel_id AS sourceChannelId, channel.channel_name AS sourceChannelName, payment.payment_address AS paymentAddress, payment.channel_yesterday_cost AS channelYesterdayCost, payment.amount, payment.remark, payment.comment, payment.audit_status AS auditStatus, payment.source_type AS sourceType, payment.feishu_card_id AS feishuCardId, payment.feishu_notice_status AS feishuNoticeStatus, payment.audit_id AS auditorSourceId, auditor.nick_name AS auditorName, auditor.phonenumber AS auditorPhone, auditor.tenant_id AS auditorTenantId, payment.audit_time AS auditTime, payment.reject_reason AS rejectReason, payment.actual_amount AS actualAmount, payment.receipt_url AS receiptUrl, payment.has_receipt AS hasReceipt, payment.create_by AS createBy, payment.create_time AS createdAt, payment.update_by AS updateBy, payment.update_time AS updatedAt FROM md_payment_apply payment LEFT JOIN sys_user requester ON requester.user_id = payment.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept department ON department.dept_id = requester.dept_id LEFT JOIN fbad_channel channel ON channel.id = payment.channel_id LEFT JOIN sys_user auditor ON auditor.user_id = payment.audit_id ORDER BY payment.id
